description: One business capability: its definition, its sub-capabilities, the external authorities it cites, WHICH catalog providers reach it with their ratings, and what it COSTS — `economics` carries how many suppliers publish a price and how opaque the market is (free), and for Understanding the entry-cost (USD/month) and marginal-cost (USD per unit, by unit) quartiles, take rate, pricing-basis mix, delivery mix and open-source alternatives, every figure graded A–D by how it was read. Accepts a slug or a BC id (e.g. "payments-card-management" or "BC-1340"). The per-tag edges WITH their evidence are get_capability_edges (Understanding). Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.
